label: VPcmV34GetCurrentRxBitRate and VPcmV34GetCurrentTxBitRate.  Run it with: tools/mutate.py --suite v34pcmrates.  EVERY MUTATION BELOW MUST LIE INSIDE ONE OF THOSE TWO: v34pcmmain.cpp also holds getMPrecvdBits, v90Phase34, VPcmV34InitiateRetrain, V34GiveINFO1dBits and indicateJaTransmission, and the v90p34, v34retrain, v34info1d and v34ja suites map the same file to four other binaries.  `obj->status == 2` in particular appears verbatim inside VPcmV34InitiateRetrain and carries a two-tab indent there, so every anchor here carries its own function's surrounding text.  Finding F1103 is the failure this avoids and finding F432 is what it costs when it is not avoided.
the receiver takes its PCM arm when the role is NOT 0x66 -- the fork read backwards
the receiver's PCM window is statuses 1..3 rather than 1..2
the receiver's window is SIGNED, so status 0 joins it
the receiver's middle arm is status 2, not status 3
the middle arm reads pac18's +0x04 rather than its first word
the middle arm scales pac18 by 2400 like the configuration arm
the demodulator is reached at +0x1758 -- the modulator -- rather than +0x175c
the receiver's default arm hands back txbits, the transmitter's half of the record
rxbits is read UNSIGNED -- movzwl where the object has movswl
the rate index is handed back unscaled
the transmitter takes its V.90 arm when the role IS 0x66 -- the fork read backwards
the transmitter's V.90 window is statuses 1..3
the transmitter's V.90 window is SIGNED, so status 0 and everything below joins it
the V.90 arm reads the demodulator at +0x175c rather than the modulator at +0x1758
the V.90 transmit gate accepts anything at or above 3
a closed V.90 gate falls out of the if instead of answering zero
the V.90 chain is one dereference short -- the count read off the FIRST pointer
the V.90 arm reads +0x4c, the V.92 one's frame record
replace: n = *(const unsigned int *)(*(const unsigned char *const *)((const unsigned char *)tx + 0x4c) + 4);

label: the V.90 arm uses the V.92 granularity, 8000/12
the V.90 arm truncates instead of rounding
the V.90 frame count is SIGNED going into the conversion
the V.92 arm answers statuses 1 and 2 rather than 2 alone
the V.92 object is the one at +0x6120, the INFO0 layout gate next door
the V.92 transmit gate accepts anything at or above 3
a closed V.92 gate falls out of the if instead of answering zero
THE V.92 GATE IS CONSUMED BY READING IT -- caught by the LINK COMPARISON alone
the V.92 chain is one dereference short
the V.92 chain reads +0x40 like the V.90 one rather than +0x4c
replace: n = *(const unsigned int *)(*(const unsigned char *const *)((const unsigned char *)tx + 0x40) + 4);

label: the V.92 arm uses the V.90 granularity, 8000/6
the V.92 arm truncates instead of rounding
the K56flex arm is status 4
the K56flex constant is 33600, the V.34 ceiling, rather than 0x7530
the K56flex arm falls out of the if to the configuration
the transmitter's default arm hands back rxbits
txbits is read UNSIGNED -- movzwl where the object has movswl
the role both functions fork on is 0x65, the other value role takes
the transmit gate is at +0x30
the gate opens on 1 rather than 3
the frame count is at +0x00 of the record rather than +0x04
